description_en: Updates the ServiceEndpoint binding, enabled/disabled status, or channel behavior configuration of an IM channel. At least one updatable field must be provided
description_zh: 更新 IM 渠道绑定的 ServiceEndpoint、启停状态或渠道行为配置。至少需要提供一个可更新字段
name: UpdateAgentIMChannel

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to display the thinking process in IM messages. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示思考过程，默认值为 false
fields.name: show_thinking

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to display the tool calling process in IM messages. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示工具调用过程，默认值为 false
fields.name: show_tool_calls

fields.help_en: The channel behavior configuration. When provided, the entire configuration is replaced. An empty object restores default values
fields.help_zh: 渠道行为配置；传入时全量替换，空对象表示恢复默认值
fields.name: channel_config

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the IM channel. Default value: true (when created)
fields.help_zh: 是否启用该 IM 渠道。创建时默认值为 true
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The ID of the bound ServiceEndpoint. The endpoint must belong to the specified agent and its current version, be in the ready state, and have a public network address
fields.help_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint ID。该端点必须属于指定智能体及其当前版本，并已就绪且具有公网地址
fields.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The reserved idempotency token. The backend does not provide persistent idempotency guarantees in the current phase
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等令牌，本期后端不提供持久化幂等保证
parameters.name: client_token
